# Obsidian Settings

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A hidden folder (`.obsidian`) in every Obsidian vault that contains settings for Obsidian and its plugins.

## Scope note

- Provides persistent storage in JSON files of settings.

## Broader

- [Vault](../Vault/)
